title: From Backlog Items to Security Guidance: Towards Continuous Security Compliance
abstract: arXiv:2607.27374v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Continuous software engineering in regulated domains requires engineering teams to address security throughout the development lifecycle. Yet making security requirements explicit in backlog items is still problematic. Engineers must instead infer security relevance of backlog items from brief, free-form descriptions and often lack timely guidance on applicable requirements. We present an NLP-based backlog enrichment system that detects security-relevant backlog items and links them to relevant security requirements. The approach combines a security-relevance classifier with a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline over security requirements documents. The approach was developed and evaluated in the context of a large enterprise in highly regulated domains. We present three contributions. translated_title: 从待办事项到安全指导：迈向持续安全合规
translated_abstract: 在受监管领域的持续软件工程中，工程团队需要在整个开发生命周期中处理安全问题。然而，在待办事项中明确表达安全要求仍然是一个难题。工程师只能从简短的自由格式描述中推断待办事项的安全相关性，并且往往缺乏关于适用安全要求的及时指导。我们提出了一种基于自然语言处理（NLP）的待办事项增强系统，该系统能够检测与安全相关的待办事项，并将其与相关的安全要求进行链接。该方法将安全相关性分类器与基于安全要求文档的检索增强生成（RAG）流水线相结合。该方法在一家高度监管领域的大型企业环境中进行开发和评估。我们提出了三项贡献。首先，我们发布了一个包含288个待办事项的数据集，这些待办事项由九位安全从业者标注了安全相关性，标注者之间具有较高的一致性（
tldr: 提出了一种基于NLP的待办事项增强系统，通过结合安全相关性分类器和基于安全要求文档的RAG流水线，自动检测安全相关的待办事项并将其链接到相应的安全要求，从而支持受监管领域的持续安全合规。
en_tdlr: An NLP-based backlog enrichment system that combines a security-relevance classifier with a RAG pipeline over security requirements documents to automatically detect security-relevant backlog items and link them to applicable security requirements, enabling continuous security compliance in regulated domains.
